summary: This note is a short encyclopedic entry describing Radwanice, a village in south-western Poland. It places the village in Polkowice County within the Lower Silesian Voivodeship and notes that it serves as the seat of Gmina Radwanice, the surrounding administrative district.
one_line: Radwanice is a village in Polkowice County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, south-western Poland, and seat of Gmina Radwanice.
key_facts: Radwanice is a village in Polkowice County.
Radwanice is located in the Lower Silesian Voivodeship.
Radwanice is situated in south-western Poland.
Radwanice is the seat of the administrative district called Gmina Radwanice.
Gmina Radwanice is an administrative district (gmina) that takes its seat in the village of Radwanice.
